title: 第25章 夺舍第26章 万魂幡不那叫人皇幡
slug: 开局签到帝经我家族独断万古
lines: 就林浩然进去秘境后的这一路遭遇，如果让林轩知道，高低得喊一声气运之子！
再看看他，刚进来就遇到比自己境界高的妖兽攻击，这要是换个普通族人不得开局就领盒饭？
后面更是一路被妖兽围攻，结果收获的资源，还没林浩然他一个灵药园收的灵药价值高，这找谁说理去！
林轩：气运之子都这么香的吗？吃这么好？
统子：宿主肤浅！有本系统在，气运之子算什么？能掏出盘古精血吗？能掏出红毛怪的红毛吗？
统子：但只要宿主你够努力，这些你都可以拥有！所以，努力吧骚年！
林轩：……感觉你在画饼。
洞府中
林浩然先是在四周那些法器里，不断的翻找着，只要没有彻底失去灵性的法器，他通通一概扔进空间戒指之中。
那些完好的简单，直接都可以使用，至于那些有灵性丢失，但未完全丢失的，就需要林家的炼器师重新锻造一番了。
最终林浩然一共收获了108把或完好或残缺的法器，品阶都是七阶之上的，最好的是一把大圣阶的大锤子。
至于七阶之下的，由于等级太低，灵性早已在漫长的时间冲刷下，消磨殆尽，变为了一堆无用的凡器。
接着他便开始一个个的查看摆在架子上的盒子，发现这些盒子都是用来装珍贵的灵药和圣药的。
不过由于时间太过漫长，且灵药保存的时间本来就无法跟法器等相比，所以其中大部分的盒子内都只剩一团药渣，林浩然一打开盒子，它们便随风而散。
不过也有一小部分灵药、圣药，保存得较为完好，虽然药性有所流失，但到底还有些价值。
林浩然不管那些，只要还有药性的，他都通通扔进空间戒指之中，至于能发挥何等的价值，就让家族的炼丹师头疼去吧。
他只负责带回去。
接着便是那些玉简和空间戒指，林浩然皆是一个个的全部查看了遍，发现了不少的功法武技，神通传承，以及其它的资源，让他嘴角根本就没压下去过……
“嘿嘿～发了，发了！”
“待回到家族将这些资源、传承上交家族后，又可以获得一大笔贡献点，小爷要泡在造化塔以及洗灵池里不出来了！”
林浩然将全部资源收完后，美美的想道。
随后他又开始往剩下的洞府走去，继续开始查看起来……
与此同时，在距离林浩然不知道多远的一处山峰之上，此时林天羽正负手而立，遥望着远方，看不出在想些什么。
而在他旁边的则是十四长老、十五长老，这两位圣人境高手，在他的身后还有数百号林家族人，恭敬的站着，等待着林天羽的命令。
显然，此时林家之人，已经基本差不多全部汇合完毕了，就剩林轩、林浩然两人以及少数十来位族人还没与他们汇合？
“还没有然儿和轩儿那两小子的消息吗？”
下一刻，林天羽眉头微蹙，缓缓问道。
对此，十四长老和十五长老两人对视一眼，随后摇了摇头。
“并未有少主和浩然那小子的消息……”
“不过二爷也不必担心，少主和浩然都不是小孩子了，他们知道保护好自己的……况且他们还有家族给予的底牌，想来不会有什么事的。”
林天羽没有回应。
过了许久才缓缓出声：“……不必再等了，所有人散开保持在离我十万里范围内，逐步朝秘境中心探索，遇到危险及时求救，我和两位长老会第一时间赶去。”
十万里范围，是林天羽神识所能笼罩的最大范围，也是他能最短时间抵达并将族人解救的范围。
content_en:
As for Lin Haoran's encounter after entering the secret realm, if Lin Xuan knew about it, he would be called the Son of Destiny!
Look at him again. As soon as he came in, he was attacked by a monster with a higher level than himself. What if it were an ordinary tribesman who would not receive a box lunch at the beginning?
Later, he was besieged by monsters all the way, and the resources he harvested were not as valuable as the elixirs collected by Lin Haoran and his elixir garden. Who can explain this!
Lin Xuan: Are all children of fortune so fragrant? Eat so well?
Tongzi: The host is superficial! With this system here, what is the son of destiny? Can you take out the Pangu essence and blood? Can you take out the red hair of the red-haired monster?
Tongzi: But as long as you work hard enough as a host, you can have all of these! So, work hard, Saonian!
Lin Xuan: ...It feels like you are drawing a cake.
…
Dong Fuzhong
Lin Haoran first rummaged through the magical artifacts around him. As long as the magical artifacts had not completely lost their spirituality, he threw them all into the space ring.
Those that are intact and simple can be used directly. As for those that have lost their spirituality but are not completely lost, they need to be reforged by the Lin family's weapon refiners.
In the end, Lin Haoran harvested a total of 108 perfect or incomplete magical weapons, all of which were above the seventh level. The best one was a big hammer of the Great Saint level.
As for those below the seventh level, because their levels are too low, their spirituality has already been washed away over a long period of time, turning them into a bunch of useless mortal weapons.
Then he began to look at the boxes on the shelves one by one, and found that these boxes were used to contain precious elixirs and holy medicines.
However, because the time was too long, and the storage time of elixirs could not be compared with magic weapons, most of the boxes contained only a ball of medicine residue. As soon as Lin Haoran opened the box, they scattered with the wind.
However, there are also a small number of elixirs and holy medicines that are relatively well preserved. Although their medicinal properties have been lost, they still have some value.
Lin Haoran didn't care about those things. As long as they still had medicinal properties, he would throw them all into the space ring. As for how valuable they could be, he would let the family's alchemist have a headache.
He is only responsible for bringing it back.
Then there were the jade slips and space rings. Lin Haoran checked them all one by one and found a lot of martial arts, magical inheritance, and other resources, which made him unable to hold his tongue at all...
"Hehe~ It's posted, it's posted!"
"After returning to the family and handing over these resources and inheritance to the family, I can get a large amount of contribution points. I will be soaked in the Creation Tower and the Spirit Cleansing Pool!"
Lin Haoran thought beautifully after collecting all the resources.
Then he started walking towards the remaining caves and continued to check...
…
At the same time, on a mountain peak not knowing how far away from Lin Haoran, Lin Tianyu was standing with his hands behind his back, looking into the distance, unable to tell what he was thinking.
Next to him were the Fourteenth Elder and the Fifteenth Elder. These two saint-level masters, and hundreds of Lin family members behind him, stood respectfully, waiting for Lin Tianyu's orders.
Obviously, at this time, almost all the people of the Lin family have gathered together. Only Lin Xuan, Lin Haoran and a few dozen clan members have not yet joined them?
"Is there no news about Ran'er and Xuan'er yet?"
The next moment, Lin Tianyu frowned slightly and asked slowly.
In response, the fourteenth elder and the fifteenth elder looked at each other, and then shook their heads.
"There is no news about the young master and that boy Haoran..."
"But there's no need to worry, Second Master. The young master and Haoran are no longer children. They know how to protect themselves... Besides, they also have the cards given by their family. I think nothing will happen to them."
Lin Tianyu did not respond.
After a long time, he slowly said: "...There is no need to wait any longer. Everyone spreads out and stays within a hundred thousand miles away from me, and gradually explores towards the center of the secret realm. If there is danger, seek help in time. The two elders and I will rush there as soon as possible."
The range of one hundred thousand miles is the maximum range that Lin Tianyu's spiritual consciousness can cover, and it is also the range that he can reach in the shortest time and rescue his tribe.
